editorialDecl.p: Diplomatic transcription of printed pages 593–615. The page image is authoritative; OCR is corrected against it. Greek verse is encoded as numbered TEI lines. Printed orthography and editorial matter are preserved; machine-generated encoding requires review.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Initial page-level extraction using deepseek-flash; prompt dindorf-aeschylus-fragments-hathi-tei-v2-2026-10-08.
Recorded 193 conservative Dindorf–Nauck fragment correspondences from normalized quoted-Greek similarity; unmatched fragments remain unlinked.
Split the aggregate Aeschylus fragment corpus into the play-level CTS work tlg0085.athamas; fragment wording was not changed.

div.note: Athenaeus II. p. 37 f. et Eustathius p. 740, 10. Ὅτι τὸ ἀρχαῖον δύο γένη τριπόδων ἦσαν, οἱ καὶ λέβητες. — Αἰσχύλος

lg.l: Τὸν μὲν τρίπους ἐδέξατ᾽ οἰκεῖος λέβης
ἀεὶ φυλάσσων τὴν ὑπὲρ πυρὸς στάσιν.

div.note: Athenæus VII. p. 316 b. Καὶ τρίπουν δὲ λέβητα Αἰσχύλος εἴρηκεν ἐν Ἀθάμαντι ἀπὸ ἁπλοῦ τοῦ ποὺς. Quæ repetit Eustathius p. 1541, 29.
Hesychius, Ἀήτους: μεγάλας. Αἰσχύλος Ἀθάμαντι. Codex ἀθάμαντας.
Hesychius, Ἀπαρτί: ἀπηρτισμένως, ἀκριβῶς. Αἰσχύλος Ἀθάμαντι. Codex ἀπαρτιᾶ.
Idem, Βρυαζούσης λεαίνης: ἐν Ἀθάμαντι (Æschyli an Sophoclis ?) ἀκμαζούσης, ἢ ἐγκύμονος.
